investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Blocked by Swarm Agent Quota Exhaustion (409 Conflict) — production-api
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-16T22:45:05–08Z with an identical 409 response from POST /api/agents: the swarm backend rejected the creation request because the org-level agent quota of 100 has been reached. Because the agent creation call failed immediately, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever written, causing the expected-output contract to be fully unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The production swarm backend returned HTTP 409 with error code "conflict" and message "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100" when the eval runner called POST /api/agents. The quota ceiling prevented agent creation from proceeding, so the runner never reached the VM-readiness or state-polling steps, leaving all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) absent. This is a production-api resource-limit condition localized to the remote-agents feature and its shared agent-creation dependency; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact is scoped to this observability eval.
